Help comes from `chupa/help.py`, which reuses a code- or doc-owned string (a status reason, a `chupa/docs/host-running.md` verb row) where one exists and writes text only where none does; settings carry theirs in `package.json` `markdownDescription`. A change that adds an extension surface or vocabulary value, or changes behavior a help entry or its linked section describes, updates that entry in the same change. `tests/unit/test_help.py` fails on a missing entry or a dead link; keeping the text true is this rule's job.
